message: [ERROR] Blocking synchronization or network routing requires a host OS.
why: sleep and until need a scheduler and condition variables; a directed emit (route == 2, `to <ctx>`) needs a live context handle to route to. Bare metal has none of these — the slot table is static addresses. Channel routing (route == 1) is deliberately not in this set: it is a compile-time hash plus an integer compare and works on bare metal.
fix: replace sleep/until with a counted or polling loop — there is no blocking wait on bare metal
route the emit by channel instead of `to <ctx>`, or move that workflow to the host side
